description: 대전광역시 서구_동물병원현황 [hospitals and health facilities] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 대전광역시 서구. 데이터를 통해 서구 지역 내 동물병원의 분포와 시설 접근성을 객관적으로 파악할 수 있으며, 반려동물 의료서비스 수요 분석, 지역 수의서비스 인프라 진단, 동물보건 정책 수립 등 다양한. Coverage: 대전광역시 서구. The portal files it under the publisher 대전광역시 서구. Its tags are 반려견, 반려동물, 강아지, 동물, 동물병원. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-11-20 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
